verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own marketing says it lets companies share diligence materials through a secure built-in data room, with advanced permissions over who can view or modify sensitive equity data. It also centralizes documents and stakeholder access, and offers shareholder equity-value visibility settings. All of this rests on one-line marketing claims, with no support article or hands-on detail on how the data room works. Missing for 10: documentation of data room setup and per-user or per-document access controls for counsel and investors, evidence that cap table views are exposed inside the data room, audit or activity tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
